description: This file provides classes and functions for normalizing and processing command output, especially tracebacks and error messages, for the behave4cmd0.command_shell module.

classes.name: LineProcessor
classes.description: Function-like object for performing text-line transformations.

classes.name: TracebackLineNormalizer
classes.description: Normalizes path lines in traceback dumps.

classes.name: ExceptionWithPathNormalizer
classes.description: Normalizes filename paths in exception lines for Windows.

classes.name: CommandOutputProcessor
classes.description: Base class for processing command output, with enable/disable and output parts.

classes.name: LineCommandOutputProcessor
classes.description: Processes text line-by-line using line processors, e.g., for normalizing tracebacks.

classes.name: TextProcessor
classes.description: Adapter to use a CommandOutputProcessor as a text normalizer.

classes.name: BehaveWinCommandOutputProcessor
classes.description: Post-processor for behave on Windows, normalizing paths and tracebacks.

methods.name: posixpath_normpath
methods.description: Normalizes Windows backslashes and double slashes in file paths to POSIX style.
